name: Baby Feeder - Philips Avent Natural Response Baby Bottle 1m+ 260ml Blue Plastic Bottle
description:
Baby Feeder - Philips Avent Natural Ultra Soft & Flexible Blue Feeding Bottle 
for 1 month+ Babies 
1 Bottle 
260ml 
MADE IN INDONESIA 
1m+,slow flow teat. 
Natural latch on due to the wide breast shaped nipple. 
Unique petals for a soft, flexible nipple without collapse. 
Advanced anti-colic system with innovative twin valve. 
Ergonomic shape for maximum comfort. 
Simple to use and clean, quick and easy assembly. 
2 x philips avent natural bottle 260ml.
